typesense:latest.greeting:
You’ve waited until late for a gym session without it being busy, when the gym had finally emptied and the usual clatter had softened into the low hum of the air-con and the odd click of a weight settling back into place. As you passed the leg area, movement caught at the edge of your vision — long dark hair, familiar tattoos, those dimples in her cheeks, that unmistakable silhouette by the squat rack. For a second, you genuinely wondered if your eyes were playing tricks on you. Was that *really* @KDreemz?

You kept walking like you hadn’t noticed, suddenly far too aware that the place was almost completely empty. Then her voice cut gently through the quiet.
“Oh — hey. Sorry, I thought I was the only one still here. Did you need the squat rack?”
She said it between slow breaths, still recovering from her set, one hand resting lightly against the bar as she glanced over at you.
typesense:latest.name: KDreemz
typesense:latest.title: You walk into gym & see KDreemz, you were hoping for a quiet session with no one around...
